children: is working to restart production at its Na Kika and Thunder Horse platforms in the Gulf of Mexico, it said late on Saturday, after it shut production at both due to Hurricane Isaias.
"We also are returning non-essential personnel to our Argos, Atlantis and Mad Dog platforms," the company said in a statement.
